description: RQ-2 epoch-level-split inflation (06 v1.1 §2 RQ-2, §6 item 3; RDR-015). Specified after RESULT-001 was unblinded; descriptive; B2 only; does not involve the FC contrast and cannot change any label. Josue chose to specify it on 2026-10-20 ("Draft RDR and config").

factor_changed.outer_split: epoch arm: label-stratified 5-fold assignment of the pooled kept epochs of the 69 primary recordings, patient identity ignored (within each class a numpy default_rng(seed) permutation dealt round-robin; seed = the frozen repeat seed of the F-3 manifest)
factor_changed.inner_split: epoch arm: the same label-stratified 5-fold assignment on the pooled epochs of the outer training set, seed = inner_folds.inner_seed(repeat seed, outer fold)
factor_changed.tuning_criterion_scores: epoch arm: the EXP-004 criterion (mean within-patient same-state AUROC, ties -> simpler) computed on inner out-of-fold scores over the patients evaluable (>= 5 IED and >= 5 non-IED in a state) in that outer training set; a patient's epochs are scored by up to 5 inner models

unchanged_from_exp004.cache: the EXP-004 feature cache (kept epochs per 06 §4.2, CAR, salience-selected 2-s window)
unchanged_from_exp004.learner: HistGradientBoostingClassifier, locked 16-point grid, max_iter 300, no early stopping; random_state = repeat seed + outer fold
unchanged_from_exp004.training_weights: R9 (each recording's epochs in the training set weighted 1/n_p, then the state ratio)

patient_grouped_arm: the EXP-004 HGB B2 outer-fold scores on the frozen manifest, reused without refitting; the summary checks that they reproduce the EXP-004 units exactly

metrics.pooled_auroc: per repeat and arm, AUROC over all held-out kept epochs of the 69 recordings (each epoch scored once per repeat)
metrics.within_patient_auroc: per repeat and arm, the 06 R2 within-patient same-state AUROC of each of the 35 evaluable patients on its out-of-fold scores; mean over patients (equal weight)

inflation: epoch arm minus patient-grouped arm, per repeat, averaged over the 10 repeats; repeat range; 95% percentile cluster bootstrap (pooled: resampling recordings; within-patient: resampling evaluable patients), 10,000 resamples, seed 20261010
reading: descriptive only: no SESOI, no taxonomy, no test. A positive pooled inflation quantifies how far epoch-level splits overstate performance on vEpiSet; the within-patient inflation shows how much the RESULT-001 estimand itself depends on the split.
